values.text: Some hotels aren’t just somewhere to sleep, they are the trip. These stays are worth travelling for. Here’s how to make the most of each one.
A former manor on its own island, reached only by boat. Expect marble floors and a lot of quiet.

values.altText: Sunlight falling through a green forest

values.text: Rooms built at treetop height, with morning walks and evening river trips.
Three suites inside a working lighthouse, with a bath that looks straight out to sea.
But wait, there’s more: a floating hotel on a loch, a suite on stilts in a vineyard, and a gloriously over-the-top retro hotel in the city.
